mining_controllersActivationRequired.en: Activate your LOOP ID before binding an invite code. You can bind any time after activation.
mining_controllersActivationRequired.zh: 需要先完成 LOOP ID 激活才能绑定邀请码。激活后随时可以再来绑定。

mining_controllersIdempotencyConflict.en: This binding was already submitted with a different invite code. Refresh to see the latest status.
mining_controllersIdempotencyConflict.zh: 同一次绑定已经用不同的邀请码提交过，请刷新查看最新状态。

mining_controllersNotFound.en: This invite code doesn't exist. Check with the person who invited you and try again; codes can't be guessed, so more attempts won't help.
mining_controllersNotFound.zh: 这个邀请码不存在。请向邀请人确认后再试；邀请码不可枚举，多次尝试不会提高成功率。

mining_controllersPolicyBlocked.en: You can't bind an invite code right now. Each account can bind only once. Refresh to see the latest status.
mining_controllersPolicyBlocked.zh: 当前不能绑定邀请码。每个账号只能绑定一次，请刷新查看最新状态。

mining_controllersStale.en: This account already has an inviter. It can't be changed after binding.
mining_controllersStale.zh: 这个账号已经绑定过邀请人。绑定后不能更换。

mining_controllersValidationFailed.en: This invite code can't be bound: you can't invite yourself or bind a code from someone you invited.
mining_controllersValidationFailed.zh: 这个邀请码不能绑定：不能邀请自己，也不能绑定自己下级的邀请码。

mining_copyHead.zh: 显示的是 {computedAtLabel} 的算力快照

mining_copyIf.en: Block and time appear here after the next power snapshot.
mining_copyIf.zh: 下一次算力快照之后，这里会显示区块与时间。

mining_copyIf2.en: The latest calculation didn't finish and there's no complete snapshot to fall back on.
mining_copyIf2.zh: 最近一次计算没有完成，没有可以回退的完整快照。

mining_copyIncomplete.en: Reference prices for some assets couldn't be read this time
mining_copyIncomplete.zh: 有资产的参考价这次读不到

mining_copyMiningConditionEmbedded.en: Calculated from holdings in wallets linked to your LOOP account.
mining_copyMiningConditionEmbedded.zh: 按绑定到 LOOP 账号的钱包持仓计算。

mining_copyMiningConditionMember.en: You must join the community; only the time you're a member counts. Tokens without a bound community don't require this.
mining_copyMiningConditionMember.zh: 你须加入该社区，按在社区的时段计入；没有绑定社区的币不要求。

mining_copyMiningConditionVerified.en: Community tokens count only when their bound community is approved; communities in review don't count.
mining_copyMiningConditionVerified.zh: 社区币只在绑定它的社区已通过审核时计入，待审核社区不算。

mining_copyMiningConditionsShort.en: Calculated from linked wallet holdings. Community tokens require joining their approved community.
mining_copyMiningConditionsShort.zh: 按绑定钱包持仓计算，社区币须加入已通过审核的绑定社区。

mining_copyS.en: The latest calculation didn't finish ({cause}) and there's no complete snapshot to fall back on.
mining_copyS.zh: 最近一次计算没有完成（{cause}），没有可以回退的完整快照。

mining_copySwitch.en: No power snapshot has been taken yet

mining_copySwitch2.zh: 还没有完整的算力快照

mining_copySwitch3.en: Shown after the next power snapshot
mining_copySwitch3.zh: 下一次算力快照之后显示

mining_copySwitch4.en: Power snapshot can't be loaded right now

mining_copySwitch5.en: {label} has no available quote right now

mining_copySwitch7.en: {label}'s reference price comes from an unregistered token
mining_copySwitch7.zh: {label} 的参考价来自未登记的代币

mining_copySwitch8.en: {label}'s reference price couldn't be read this time

mining_copySwitch9.zh: 那次快照的数据不完整

mining_modelsMiningBaselineDetail.en: Token power = amount held × asset weight, not multiplied by price; NFT power = amount held × community factor. Community tokens count only when their bound community is approved and you've joined it. Calculated from holdings in wallets linked to your LOOP account. Current version: every asset's weight is 1, the daily output is an estimate, and the reward token isn't decided yet. These numbers aren't earnings or a promise.
mining_modelsMiningBaselineDetail.zh: 持币算力 = 持有数量 × 资产权重，不乘价格；NFT 算力 = 持有数量 × 所属社区系数。社区币只在绑定它的社区已通过审核、且你已加入该社区时计入。按绑定到 LOOP 账号的钱包持仓计算。当前版本：每个资产的权重都定为 1，当日产量为预估值，奖励代币还没有确定。算出来的数字不是收益，也不构成承诺。

mining_modelsSwitch.zh: 算力 = 持有量 × 权重

mining_modelsSwitch12.zh: 与 LOOP 的合作深度

mining_modelsSwitch13.en: TWAP (time-weighted average price): keeps a single trade from skewing the reference price.
mining_modelsSwitch13.zh: TWAP 时间加权均价：避免单笔成交扭曲参考价。

mining_modelsSwitch14.en: Multi-period, multi-source comparison to cross-check unusual moves.
mining_modelsSwitch14.zh: 多周期、多渠道比对，交叉验证异常波动。

mining_modelsSwitch15.en: Liquidity cap: limits the value counted for low-liquidity assets.
mining_modelsSwitch15.zh: Liquidity Cap：低流动性资产限制可计入价值。

mining_modelsSwitch17.en: Whether others see an alias or "Anonymous member" depends only on that account's anonymous mode; "Discoverable" isn't involved, and you always see your own alias.
mining_modelsSwitch17.zh: 别人看到的是别名还是「匿名成员」，只由该账号的匿名模式决定；「可被发现」不参与，自己永远看得到自己的别名。

mining_modelsSwitch18.en: Power values follow that account's own "Mining power" visibility; when set to only me, others can't see the value, but rank and entry counts stay public.
mining_modelsSwitch18.zh: 算力数值按该账号自己的「挖矿算力」可见范围显示；设为仅自己时别人看不到数值，名次与参与条目数仍然公开。

mining_modelsSwitch19.en: A rule item defined by LOOP.

mining_modelsSwitch2.zh: 算力 = 持有量 × 参考价 × 权重

mining_modelsSwitch3.en: Daily output = my power ÷ network power × daily output
mining_modelsSwitch3.zh: 每日产出 = 我的算力 ÷ 全网算力 × 当日产量

mining_modelsSwitch4.en: LOOP uses a fixed top weight tier (value pending approval).
mining_modelsSwitch4.zh: LOOP 采用固定的最高权重档位（数值待批准）。

mining_modelsSwitch5.en: Community token weights are granted by review; the range is pending approval.
mining_modelsSwitch5.zh: 社区币权重按审核结果授予，区间待批准。

mining_referralBuild3.en: Enter the invite code any time after signing up and mine together.
mining_referralBuild3.zh: 注册后随时可以填写邀请码，一起挖矿。

mining_referralBuild4.zh: 在 LOOP 注册后填写邀请码

mining_referralBuild5.zh: 已绑定邀请人，关系锁定后不能更换

mining_referralBuild6.en: Each account can bind only once, and the relation can't be changed once locked. You can't bind your own code or a code from someone you invited.
mining_referralBuild6.zh: 一个账号只能绑定一次，关系锁定后不可更换。不能绑定自己的邀请码，也不能绑定自己下级的邀请码。

mining_referralEmptyReason.en: Invite code and invite count can't be loaded right now.
mining_referralEmptyReason.zh: 暂时读不到邀请码和邀请人数。

mining_referralErrorText.en: Invalid invite code format. Check it and try again.
mining_referralErrorText.zh: 邀请码格式不对，请检查后再试。

mining_referralIf.en: Mine with me on LOOP. Sign up and enter my invite code {code}
mining_referralIf.zh: 来 LOOP 一起挖矿，注册后填写我的邀请码 {code}

mining_referralMessage.zh: 这个账号已经绑定过邀请人，邀请链接里的 {code} 不会再绑定

mining_referralMessage2.en: This account can't bind an invite code right now, so {code} from the invite link wasn't submitted
mining_referralMessage2.zh: 这个账号现在不能绑定邀请码，邀请链接里的 {code} 没有提交

mining_referralReferralClaimShapeInvalid.en: An invite code is LOOP- followed by 5 characters. Clearly invalid codes aren't submitted, so your one binding isn't wasted.
mining_referralReferralClaimShapeInvalid.zh: 邀请码形如 LOOP- 加 5 位字符。格式明显不对时不会提交，以免浪费唯一的一次绑定机会。

mining_referralReferralClaimSuccessBody.en: This relation is confirmed. It can't be changed after binding.
mining_referralReferralClaimSuccessBody.zh: 这条关系已确认。绑定后不能更换。

mining_referralReferralClaimWindowTimed.en: You can't bind an invite code right now. Refresh and try again later
mining_referralReferralClaimWindowTimed.zh: 当前不能绑定邀请码，请稍后刷新再试

mining_referralReferralInfoBindingBody.en: Invitees can bind any time after activating their LOOP ID; each account can bind only once, and the relation can't be changed once locked. You can't bind your own code or a code from someone you invited.
mining_referralReferralInfoBindingBody.zh: 被邀请人激活 LOOP ID 后随时可以绑定；一个账号只能绑定一次，关系锁定后不可更换。不能绑定自己的邀请码，也不能绑定自己下级的邀请码。

mining_referralReferralInfoDepthBody.en: People you invite directly and who are verified are L1, people L1 invites are L2, and so on{rules}. Each level's boost rate follows what the server publishes and counts only that level's active relations.
mining_referralReferralInfoDepthBody.zh: 你直接邀请并已验证的人是 L1，L1 再邀请的人是 L2，依此类推{rules}。每一级的加成比例以服务端公布的为准，只按该级的有效关系计入。

mining_referralReferralInfoMiningOnlyBod.en: Invite boost counts only toward mining power. It isn't income, commission or a rebate.
mining_referralReferralInfoMiningOnlyBod.zh: 邀请加成只计入挖矿算力，不是收入、佣金或返佣。

mining_referralReferralInfoRelationshipB.en: Each account has one invite code. Sharing doesn't create a relation until it's verified; "Active" counts only verified relations, and the rest show as pending verification and add no boost.{overview}

mining_referralReferralPosterNoLink.zh: 邀请链接还没有开放，海报上只印邀请码。

mining_secondaryScreensLoopFolioPrimary.zh: 还没有已批准的公式，也没有待批准的草案。

mining_secondaryScreensLoopFolioPrimary3.zh: 这一版已批准，当前生效；没有待批准的草案。

mining_secondaryScreensMiningRulesNotice.zh: 待批准的版本不会参与任何计算。权重区间只有规则条目，没有数值；批准之后才会公布。

mining_secondaryScreensSwitch2.zh: 社区总算力读到之后显示在这里。

mining_secondaryScreensSwitch3.zh: 这一页还没有读到这个社区的算力。

mining_secondaryScreensSwitch4.en: Weights are granted by platform review and are already included in the power above.
mining_secondaryScreensSwitch4.zh: 权重由平台审核结果授予，已经算在上面的算力里。
